Name: Sebastian to Akechi
Author: SweetishLemon
Description:
Turns Sebastian into Goro Akechi from Persona 5. Sprites and all. Portraits are from persona 5 royal, sprites are all mine. This doesn't change any of the dialogue.

Unfortunately portraits will only work with Portraiture at the moment, so move the PNGs over to the portraiture mod folder. Feel free to review my code and check to see why portraits wont work properly! If you figure out why, please leave a comment letting me know how to fix it, thank you!

Ps- change the portrait file names to "Sebastian" "Sebastian_Beach" and "Sebastian_Winter"!
